items.t: Amgen (AMGN) Has Advanced MariTide Into Phase 3 Trials
items.sum: Amgen (NasdaqGS:AMGN) has advanced its obesity drug candidate MariTide into Phase 3 clinical trials, targeting the growing anti-obesity treatment market. The firm is positioning MariTide to compete with existing anti-obesity therapies from established players such as Eli Lilly and Novo Nordisk.
